dedupe_keys.name: digitised weekly murrumbidgee river heights southeastern australia 1873 to 2017

description: The Climate Change Research Centre at the University of New South Wales publishes digitised weekly river heights for Hay on the Murrumbidgee River. The series covers November 1873 to June 2017 in southeastern Australia, with one complete spreadsheet and separate seasonal spreadsheets. The archive was prepared to support study of long-term flow behaviour, climate variability and catchment development. Zenodo makes the XLSX files publicly available and free under CC-BY-4.0. A limitation is that river height is not discharge, and the landing page does not establish a consistent vertical datum or rating curve across the full period. Weekly sampling may also miss short flood peaks. The records can constrain long-term hydrological variability and provide historical checks on catchment simulations. They complement contemporary river gauges with a much longer local series, not replacing event-scale hydraulic observations. The measurements were not downloaded or recalculated.
